dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, forming a fusiform profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey clusters localized primarily on the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light-grey baseline and the darker posterior mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, faint longitudinal linear mark visible on the left-posterior dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Longitudinal linear mark on the left side of the posterior dorsal area, consistent with a healed rake mark or superficial scratch.
